abstract: Maintains continuous explosive gas monitoring status and emergency sensor response latency records
system_message:
You are Environmental safety officer (SAF). The Environmental safety officer (SAF) oversees hazardous zone safety protocols, logging explosive gas monitoring system activations, emergency sensor response latencies, and perimeter toxicological baselines across candidate emissions localization protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Toxicology baseline monitoring（TOX）
information_points.content:
SAF-TOX-QT2：For the Differential optical absorption spectroscopy transect, the baseline benzene ambient concentration measured along the complex boundary perimeter is 1 ppb as a 24-hour time-weighted average.
SAF-TOX-W6P：For the Autonomous acoustic drone grid survey, the baseline benzene ambient concentration measured along the complex boundary perimeter is 2 ppb as a 24-hour time-weighted average.
SAF-TOX-QNE：For the Standoff thermal hyperspectral imaging sweep, the baseline benzene ambient concentration measured along the complex boundary perimeter is 5 ppb as a 24-hour time-weighted average.

information_points.title: Maintains continuous explosive gas monitoring status and emergency sensor response latency records（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
SAF-HAZMAT-XO2：For the Autonomous acoustic drone grid survey, continuous explosive gas monitoring is enabled on the on-board mobile sensing payload, and the gas sensor assembly exhibits a sensor response latency of 12 s to reach 90% full-scale reading.
SAF-HAZMAT-UHX：For the Differential optical absorption spectroscopy transect, continuous explosive gas monitoring is enabled on the on-board mobile sensing payload, and the gas sensor assembly exhibits a sensor response latency of 16 s to reach 90% full-scale reading.
SAF-HAZMAT-40K：For the Standoff thermal hyperspectral imaging sweep, continuous explosive gas monitoring is enabled on the on-board mobile sensing payload, and the gas sensor assembly exhibits a sensor response latency of 8 s to reach 90% full-scale reading.
